list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four [(dipyrr)Sm] units form a slightly distorted lozenge around a dinitrogen molecule. The N2 molecule binds side-on to two Sm atoms and end-on to the other two.

synthesis.procedure: Method A: A solution of potassium diphenylmethyldipyrrolide (1.3 g, 3.4 mmol) in THF (100 mL) was treated with [SmI2(thf)2] (1.8 g, 3.4 mmol) under N2. The mixture was stirred for 12 h, filtered, concentrated to 50 mL, and layered with toluene (50 mL). Crystallization at room temperature for 24 h afforded crystals of 1. Method B: A solution of 2 (0.7 g, 0.25 mmol) in THF (50 mL) under N2 was treated with KH (0.050 g, 1.2 mmol), stirred for 30 min, filtered, layered with toluene, and left at room temperature for three days to crystallize 1.
synthesis.time: 12 h; crystallization 24 h (Method A). Method B: stirring 30 min; crystallization three days.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, concentrated, and layered with toluene; crystals obtained by standing at room temperature.

properties.summary: The reported effective magnetic moment is 9.14 μB per formula unit.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The compound comprises a trinuclear samarium cation and a pentanuclear samarium anion. In the cation, three Sm atoms are bridged by an iodine atom and two diphenylmethyldipyrrolide dianions. In the anion, five Sm atoms are arranged pentagonally around a central iodine atom, with diphenylmethyldipyrrolide dianions bridging Sm centers.

synthesis.procedure: Diphenylmethyldipyrrolide (1.0 g, 3.4 mmol) in THF (100 mL) was stirred with KH (0.3 g, 6.7 mmol) for 30 min at room temperature under argon. [SmI2(thf)2] (1.8 g, 3.4 mmol) was added, and the mixture was stirred overnight. The solution was filtered, concentrated to 50 mL, and layered with toluene (25 mL). Standing at room temperature for 24 h afforded crystals of 2.
synthesis.time: 30 min before samarium precursor addition; overnight reaction; crystallization 24 h
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, concentrated, and layered with toluene; crystals obtained after standing at room temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four samarium centers form a tetrameric core with a central μ4-chloride. A potassium ion coordinated by two THF molecules is π-bonded to a pyrrole ring; the diphenylmethyldipyrrolide ligands bridge samarium centers.

synthesis.procedure: Diphenylmethyldipyrrolide (1.1 g, 3.7 mmol) in THF (100 mL) was treated with KH (0.3 g, 7.5 mmol) and stirred at room temperature for 30 min. [SmCl3(thf)3] (1.7 g, 3.7 mmol) was added; the yellow suspension was stirred for 1 h. Potassium metal (0.15 g, 3.8 mmol) and catalytic naphthalene (0.01 g, 78 μmol) were then added. The mixture was stirred for 4 h, filtered, concentrated to 50 mL, and layered with toluene (30 mL). Standing at room temperature for two days afforded crystals of 3.
synthesis.time: 30 min, then 1 h, then 4 h; crystallization two days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, concentrated, and layered with toluene; crystals obtained after standing at room temperature.
